When it comes to snow reliability, Montchavin-Les Coches is in a strong position: its highest point at 3250 m means the upper runs hold up well until April, even in capricious winters. The budget for a stay in Montchavin-Les Coches is clearly high: 72€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps.
